title: What kind of reset do you actually need right now?
intro: Not everyone recharges the same way. Some people need quiet. Some need movement. Some need emotional release, connection, or structure. This check-in is designed to help you identify what type of recovery and nervous system support may help you feel more regulated right now.

questions.text: When I'm overwhelmed, I usually feel better through:
When stress builds up, I usually need:
Right now, my nervous system probably needs:

options.text: I've moved my body or released energy
I've had time to emotionally process things
I feel emotionally understood by others
I feel organized and back in control

questions.text: What do you need most right now?

a.description: You feel more grounded and regulated through movement, activity, or physical release. Your body holds tension — and moving helps you let it go.

b.description: You need calm, rest, and low-stimulation environments to recover emotionally. Quiet isn't avoidance for you — it's how you heal.

c.description: You need emotional expression, reflection, or connection to process stress. Putting feelings into words helps you move through them.

d.description: You feel restored through support, connection, and feeling understood by others. Being with people who get you helps you feel like yourself again.

e.description: You feel calmer with routines, structure, organization, and a sense of stability. When things feel predictable, your nervous system can finally relax.
